public bool ChainCanLaunch=>IsPlaying&&!IsPaused&&!RefillFreezeBalls&&!CollectionGoalEarned&&Shots>0&&PendingBurstBalls==0&&!queuedShot.HasValue&&simulationClock+.00001f>=chainNextLaunch;
chainNextLaunch=simulationClock+.55f;

void BeginAim(Vector2 pos,int id){if(aiming)return;if(UIBlocked(pos)){BattleInputStatus="ui-hit";return;}if(gameCamera==null||!gameCamera.pixelRect.Contains(pos)){BattleInputStatus="outside";return;}if(Session.GardenDecor!=null&&Session.GardenDecor.TryTap(gameCamera.ScreenToWorldPoint(pos)))return;if(Session.IsCollection&&Session.CollectionTool!=0){Session.UseCollectionTool(BoardDisplay.Inverse(gameCamera.ScreenToWorldPoint(pos)));return;}if(Session.IsAbilityRoute&&Session.ActiveBalls>0){Session.ActivateAbility();return;}aiming=true;BattleInputStatus="aiming";NotifyTutorialPointer(true);pointerId=id;pointerStart=pos;Metrics?.Balance?.StrategyInput("begin",aimDirection);UpdateAim(pos);}

void UpdateAim(Vector2 pos){if(!aiming)return;var w=BoardDisplay.Inverse(CameraJuice.StableScreenToWorld(gameCamera,pos));var d=w-Session.LauncherPosition;if(d.y<.2f)d.y=.2f;if(d.sqrMagnitude<.01f)d=Vector2.up;aimDirection=d.normalized;Metrics?.Balance?.StrategyInput("adjust",aimDirection);Session.SetAim(aimDirection);}

void EndAim(Vector2 pos){if(!aiming)return;bool valid=(pos-pointerStart).sqrMagnitude>36&&gameCamera.pixelRect.Contains(pos);if(Array.IndexOf(Environment.GetCommandLineArgs(),"--demo-record")>=0)Debug.Log("DEMO_AIM start="+pointerStart+" end="+pos+" valid="+valid+" paused="+Session.IsPaused);var dir=aimDirection;Metrics?.Balance?.StrategyInput(valid?"release":"cancel",dir);CancelAim();if(valid&&Session.TryShoot(dir)){Metrics?.AcceptedRelease();BattleAcceptedShots++;BattleInputStatus="accepted";if(tutorialStep==1)ShowTutorial(2);}else BattleInputStatus=valid?"shot-wait":"short/outside";}
void CancelAim(){if(aiming){Metrics?.Balance?.StrategyInput("cancel",aimDirection);NotifyTutorialPointer(false);}aiming=false;pointerId=-999;if(Session!=null)Session.SetAim(null);}

bool UIBlocked(Vector2 pos){if(EventSystem.current==null)return false;uiHits.Clear();var data=new PointerEventData(EventSystem.current){position=pos};EventSystem.current.RaycastAll(data,uiHits);return uiHits.Count>0;}
